propositions: Pandoc subprocess can hang indefinitely on pathological input; the landed renderer uses subprocess.run(timeout=30) which reaps only the direct child, leaving CPU-spinning grandchildren orphaned.
The renderer must use subprocess.Popen with start_new_session=True, caller-side communicate(timeout=dc_pandoc_timeout_s), and reap_process_group on TimeoutExpired to kill the entire process group.
A configurable timeout (reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s, default 10s) must be plumbed through config schema, sources, and documentation without changing per-unit fallback semantics.

The pypandoc-binary wheel (GPL-licensed pandoc binary) must be pinned to exactly one version in pyproject.toml and verified in CI; a new repo-root NOTICE file must record pandoc's name, version 3.6.1, and GPL license.
